rubric.common: 0 observed failure; 1 below targets; 2 useful limited sample; 3 meets dimension's pilot target with adequate sample; 4 repeated target success across strata; 5 independently reviewed repeated target success including required edge cases. Never assign ratings from docs, output counts or unknown judgments.
rubric.discovery: 3 requires >=80% reviewed relevance and >=30 unique reviewed discovery records; report Wilson interval and strata, not population recall
rubric.multilingual: 3 requires three live non-English languages and >1 evidenced region; query market alone does not evidence a region
rubric.media: 3 requires separate working post image, carousel, comments, replies and attached-comment-image checks with applicability denominators; missing/unsupported never silently excluded
rubric.fidelity: 3 requires >=90% reference retrieval across >=10 accessible applicable independent references, attributable IDs/URLs and no invented geography/entity
rubric.repeat: 3 requires real second call and stable identities/schema with dedupe/restart/deletion checks; cache replay is not provider reliability
rubric.cost: 3 requires enforceable zero spend over repeat runs plus recurring free allowance sufficient for declared scenario and permission/maintenance review
rubric.unmeasured: No rating, verified points 0, tested coverage 0; zero points here means no evidence, not observed bad quality
